lead.headline: Late-time OTOCs in Toda conformal field theory
body: We study late-time out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs) of semi-degenerate primary fields in two-dimensional $A_{N-1}$ Toda conformal field theory. In Liouville theory ($N=2$), we find that the OTOC decays as $t^{-3/2}$ when the continuum edge dominates, correcting a previously reported constant limit.

For $N=3$, a transverse contour pinch reduces the spectral integral to one dimension. Assuming that the reduced expansion is complete, in the continuous phase the regulated edge behaves as a discrete state, and the OTOC approaches a pure braiding phase.

As we check numerically, the edge block is a free-field correlator in a charge-neutral Weyl frame; this explains the pure phase and is consistent with crossing symmetry. For both $N=2$ and $N=3$, a dominant discrete residue gives a constant late-time limit.

features.headline: Interfaces in Long Range CFT$_1$
body: We consider interfaces in the theory of a single free scalar in AdS$_2$ defined by adding relevant operators along portions of the boundary. We begin with Neumann/Dirichlet interfaces, computing the associated scaling dimension and $g$-factor ratio; we also explain how arbitrary interface correlators can be computed numerically efficiently.
Then we move on to interfaces between generalized free field and long-range interacting theories such as long range Ising, determining many quantities in perturbation theory.
features.authors: Bastien Girault and Miguel F. Paulos

features.headline: RMT${}_2$: Random Spectral Correlations for CFT${}_2$ and AdS${}_3$ Gravity
body: We present the full framework of RMT${}_2$, a consistent unification of random matrix theory and modular invariance. The systematic prescription, which augments the existing construction by incorporating spin, lifts random matrix correlators to $\text{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$ Poincaré sums of their Mellin transforms, in a manner which enforces random matrix correlations near extremality in every spinning primary sector.
The resulting RMT${}_2$ correlators are further expressible in terms of an orthogonal basis of Eisenstein series and Maass cusp forms.

features.headline: Defect Correlators from Supergravity: Finding the Missing Contact Terms
body: We resolve a puzzle in the computation of holographic correlators using supergravity when defects are present. Previous direct supergravity calculations of defect two-point functions were found to differ from bootstrap results by a set of contact contributions.

We show that the discrepancy arises from two effects: nonlinear Kaluza-Klein field redefinitions in the bulk, which induce additional quadratic couplings when applied consistently to localized sources, and off-shell terms in mixed bulk--defect vertices, which can collapse internal defect propagators.

stories.headline: Bounds on Love Numbers and Quasinormal Modes from the Surface Impedance
body: The surface impedance of a body is fixed by its interior alone and encodes its entire tidal response. We derive bounds on Love numbers and quasinormal modes from constraints on the impedance that follow from either of two properties of a stable body: it is lossless, meaning that it dissipates no energy, or it is passive, meaning that it never gives back more energy than it has received.
stories.authors: Daniel McLoughlin and Mikhail P. Solon

stories.headline: The String Theory Photinoverse
body: Type-IIB string compactifications typically give rise to a significant number of RR-photons. These are generically massless and do not possess any light charged states, making them `superhidden'.
However, since supersymmetry is present at least at some high scale, corresponding `dark photinos' are also predicted.

stories.headline: The all-loop spectrum of GGK strings
body: We study the non-perturbative spectrum of the non-relativistic limit of string theory in AdS$_5\times$S$^5$, also known as GGK theory. In light-cone gauge, we show that the bosonic spectrum on a number of vacua is described at all-loops by free massive and massless scalar fields in AdS$_2$, confirming a conjecture by de Leeuw, Fontanella and Nieto-García, arXiv:2403.09563.

stories.headline: Machine Learning for Calabi--Yau Geometry and Heterotic Compactification
body: Quantitative predictions from string compactification depend on geometric data that are difficult to compute analytically. This review surveys machine learning approaches to predicting topological properties of Calabi-Yau manifolds, discusses the search for new Calabi-Yau fourfolds, as well as numerical methods for approximating Ricci-flat metrics.
stories.authors: Vishnu Jejjala and Damian Mayorga Pena

stories.headline: A Pole-Cut Formula for Holographic Extremal Correlators
body: We show that the holographic spectral function of a neutral massless scalar on the extremal Reissner-Nordstrom black brane in $AdS_5$ admits an elegant formula in terms of the quasi-normal modes (QNMs) and branch-cut data. In the extremal case, the spectral data comprises the zeros of the boundary source function, i.e. the QNMs, as well as its phase discontinuity across the branch cut on the negative imaginary axis of the complex frequency plane.

stories.headline: Higher derivatives and ghosts through three centuries
body: We outline the history of the research of dynamic systems including higher derivatives in the Lagrangian, The story starts in 1744 when Euler published a book where the Euler--Lagrange differential equations for a HD system were first written. The next important landmarks were the papers of Ostrogradsky (1850) and of Pais and Uhlenbeck (1950).

stories.headline: Identifying Renormalization Group Interfaces of Massless WZW Flows $\widehat{\mathfrak{su}}(2)_k \to \widehat{\mathfrak{su}}(2)_1$
body: A renormalization-group interface encodes how a flow relates operators at short and long distances. We identify this interface up to topological dressing for the conjectured massless $\widehat{\mathfrak{su}}(2)_k \to \widehat{\mathfrak{su}}(2)_1$ Wess-Zumino-Witten flows at every odd level $k\geq 3$.

stories.headline: Character expansion of the Itzykson-Zuber pair correlator
body: We revisit a long-standing problem of correlation functions with the Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber measure. The immediate goal is to reproduce the long-known answer for pair correlator in the form of character expansion - a sum over Schur polynomials with carefully adjusted coefficients.

sections.name: Across the Border
sections.note: Papers whose primary category is not hep-th (mostly gr-qc), cross-listed into it

stories.headline: Lorentz charges for Lovelock gravity
body: In this paper, we construct the charges associated with the residual local Lorentz transformations on a black hole horizon in the Lovelock class of theories of gravity. The horizons is assumed to be non- expanding horizons, \emph{i.e} a null hypersurface for which the expansion corresponding to the null generator vanish.

stories.headline: Resolving the Conformal Mode Problem with Einstein-Cartan Gravity
body: We show that, when $Λ> 0$, the conformal factor problem is absent in first order Einstein-Cartan gravity in which the spin connection and tetrad are independent off-shell. At fixed connection, a conformal rescaling of the tetrad produces no conformal kinetic term so that the action is bounded from below.

briefs.headline: An algebraic quantization of gravity from the null cone
briefs.text: We propose a background independent quantization of vacuum general relativity on four dimensional Lorentzian spacetimes.

briefs.headline: Power-law tunneling in the Razavy hyperbolic double well: Heun connection formulas and their resonances
briefs.text: We study nonperturbative level splitting in the symmetric Razavy hyperbolic double well, relating its double-confluent Heun connection problem to exact WKB and quasi-exact solvability.

briefs.headline: Rényi multi-entropy from Riemann surfaces
briefs.text: We compute vacuum tripartite Rényi multi-entropy in a two-dimensional compact-boson conformal field theory (CFT).

briefs.headline: Time-weighted energy correlators are infrared unsafe in gauge theories
briefs.text: Energy correlators are infrared safe because each detector weights a parton by its energy, but a weight in the arrival time makes them infrared unsafe in gauge theories.

briefs.headline: Entanglement and HBAR entropy in a Lorentzian non-commutative black hole
briefs.text: We investigate how Lorentzian non-commutative smearing affects entanglement and horizon brightened acceleration radiation (HBAR) outside a black hole.
briefs.authors: A. A. Araújo Filho et al.

briefs.headline: Black hole entropy from angular holonomies of Sine-Gordon soliton lattices in AdS$_3$
briefs.text: We construct boundary conditions for AdS$_3$ gravity that realize Sine-Gordon dynamics.

briefs.headline: An Argument for the Weak Gravity Conjecture from Constrained Wormholes
briefs.text: The gravitational path integral (GPI) computes inner products between states of open and closed universes in any low-energy effective theory.

briefs.headline: Energy plateau cascades from complex-time local quenches in thermal two-dimensional CFTs
briefs.text: In this work, we study local operator quenches in thermal two-dimensional conformal field theories with complex-time evolution, which can be viewed as an effective description of conditional dynamics in a system interacting with an environment.
briefs.authors: Dmitry S. Ageev and Vladimir A. Bykov

briefs.headline: Unitarization from Spin Geometry
briefs.text: We derive the dimensional reduction of 10D super Yang-Mills theory on a general closed 6D spin manifold using spectral decompositions for the higher-dimensional gauge field and gaugino, keeping the infinite towers of Kaluza-Klein (KK) modes in the lower-dimensional theory.

briefs.headline: The black hole IR triangle for scalar QED
briefs.text: We construct the black hole infrared triangle of scalar QED on a stretched Schwarzschild horizon at tree level.

briefs.headline: Vacuum correlation measures as CFT partition functions
briefs.text: We show that in any $d$-dimensional CFT, the vacuum sandwiched Rényi mutual information (SRMI) of integer order $n$ between two disjoint balls maps to a CFT partition function on a manifold of topology $\#^{n-1}(S^1 \times S^{d-1})$, with moduli fixed by the ball configuration and single-ball modular flow.

briefs.headline: Massive Triangle in Cosmological Correlator beyond Conformal Coupling
briefs.text: A massive scalar coupled in pairs to the inflaton generates a one-loop primordial bispectrum whose mass corrections at generic momenta have lacked closed analytic expressions beyond conformal coupling.
briefs.authors: Taushif Ahmed and Syed Mehedi Hasan

briefs.headline: Reconstructing massive quivers on a defect circle
briefs.text: We study the kink and particle spectra for the massive $φ_{2,1}$-deformations of minimal models $\mathcal M_{k+1,k+2}$ via truncated conformal space approach (TCSA) on a defect circle.

briefs.headline: Neural Network Field Theory and the AdS/CFT Correspondence
briefs.text: We develop a neural realization of massive scalar field theory on Euclidean anti--de Sitter space and its holographic boundary observables within neural network field theory (NN--FT).

briefs.headline: Gauge groups of type 0 orientifolds
briefs.text: We determine the global form of the gauge groups of the orthogonal and symplectic type 0 orientifolds, using the constraints from perturbative and brane states.

briefs.headline: Logarithmic scalar soft factorization from matching conditions
briefs.text: Logarithmic soft theorems in QED and gravity can be understood as conservation laws associated with asymptotic symmetries.

briefs.headline: Superconformal Index Identities for Dual Gauge Theories
briefs.text: We study superconformal index identities for three classes of dual four-dimensional gauge theories.

briefs.headline: All known supersymmetric $\mathrm{AdS}_4 \times S^7$ uplifts from maximal supergravity
briefs.text: The solutions of $D=4$ $\mathcal N=8$ SO(8)-gauged supergravity uplift consistently to eleven dimensions.

briefs.headline: On the Structure Constants of ${\cal N}=2$ Liouville Theory
briefs.text: We show the structure constants of $\mathcal{N}=2$ spacelike Liouville theory.

briefs.headline: Chaotic singularities inside vacuum black holes
briefs.text: According to the conjecture of Belinski, Khalatnikov and Lifshitz, general relativity gives rise to chaotic dynamics in the vicinity of generic spacelike singularities.
briefs.authors: Robie A. Hennigar and Ayan K. Patra

briefs.headline: The OPE of lines beyond CFT
briefs.text: We discuss the fusion of parallel line defects in theories defined by relevant deformations of a conformal fixed point.

briefs.headline: The Dirac equation in arbitrary coordinate systems and curved spacetimes - An orthonormal frames approach
briefs.text: In this pedagogical article we discuss the Dirac equation in arbitrary coordinate systems.

briefs.headline: Holographic probes and Krylov complexity on asymptotically Lifshitz rotating black branes
briefs.text: We study two types of holographic probes on a five-dimensional, asymptotically Lifshitz, rotating black hole.

briefs.headline: Quark-Loop Corrections and Auxiliary Field-Strength Mixing in First-Order QCD
briefs.text: In the first-order formulation of Yang-Mills theory the gluon field strength is an independent auxiliary field $F$, and the only gluon self-interaction is a momentum-independent cubic vertex.

briefs.headline: Robin--Hadamard states for unstable field in half-Minkowski spacetime
briefs.text: We investigate the quantization of a real massless scalar field in four-dimensional half-Minkowski spacetime subject to an attractive Robin boundary condition.

briefs.headline: Probe branes from equivariant volumes
briefs.text: Classical Euclidean probe actions control non-perturbative weights and extended observables in holography.
briefs.authors: Kiril Hristov and Pedro Vicente Marto
